inlineSql: SELECT PR_NAME As Product,PR_CODE as Code FROM PRODUCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY PR_NAME
SELECT GR_NAME As GrName,GR_CODE as Code FROM GROUP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY GR_NAME

INSERT INTO TAG_STOCK_PRINT(CO_CODE,LC_CODE,CO_YEAR,CO_BOOK,VCH_NO,SR_NO,VCH_DATE,VCH_TYPE,INOUT_TYPE,BOOK_NAME, IT_CODE,TAG_NO,VCH_SRNO,ITM_SIGN,DESIGN_NO,ITM_SIZE,TBL_CODE,ITM_QTY,ITM_PCS,ITM_GWT,ITM_NWT,ITM_FINE,DATA_TYPE) SELECT CO_CODE,LC_CODE,CO_YEAR,CO_BOOK,VCH_NO,SR_NO,VCH_DATE,VCH_TYPE,INOUT_TYPE,BOOK_NAME, IT_CODE,TAG_NO,VCH_SRNO,'+',DESIGN_NO,ITM_SIZE,TBL_CODE,1,ITM_PCS,ITM_GWT,ITM_NWT,ITM_FINE,'A' FROM BAR_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND TAG_NO =' ? ' AND VCH_SRNO = ?

SELECT A.TAG_NO,A.IT_CODE,B.IT_NAME,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_SIZE,C.ITM_PCS,C.ITM_GWT,C.VCH_SRNO,C.ITM_NWT ,C.ITM_FINE,C.LBR_AMT,C.OTH_AMT,C.CO_BOOK,C.VCH_NO,C.VCH_DATE,C.VCH_TYPE,C.BOOK_NAME,C.AC_CODE,C.ITM_MRP,C.KR_NAME,C.TBL_CODE,C.APR_ISU,C.EMP_ISU, SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN 1 ELSE - 1 END) AS OpPcs from ((MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.LC_CODE = C.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO )LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE)LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = D.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = D.CO_BOOK WHERE ? Y ? A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND ? A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO <> 'N' AND A.TAG_NO <> '' AND A.VCH_DATE < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '

SELECT A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,COUNT(*) As PhyPcs FROM (BAR_CAN_DETL AS A INNER JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = C.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE ? Y ? A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND ? A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = '077' AND A.TAG_NO <> 'N'
Select * From ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT A.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE As ItCodeL FROM ITEM_MAST AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.IT_CODE
Select * From TABLE_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND TABLE_CODE = ' ? '
